data.title: Two underwater vehicles are working in two U.S. offshore markets for Nauticus Robotics
data.description: One system supports offshore wind development in the Northeast while the other inspects a Gulf Coast platform; bids also cover U.S. and international projects.
data.author: Stock Titan
